does_not_measure: population HLA diversity (THP-1 is a single-genotype cell line)
protocol.estimate_basis: Durations are coarse engineering estimates, not measured; cost is unsourced.
protocol.falsifier: At the in-vitro stage this candidate is falsified if EITHER (a) it cannot be expressed soluble and purified to the endotoxin limit, OR (b) the cytokine/transcript response does not exceed the endotoxin-matched LPS control and the polymyxin B-treated arm. A response explained by residual endotoxin is not evidence for the antigen.

steps.gate: Sequence cleared by S12 biosecurity screening before ordering. The S8 stage writes the order list (protein FASTA; the vendor back-translates it) to RUN_DIR/data/s8/order.fasta; check it with `python -m vaxforge.s12_biosafety check RUN_DIR/data/s8/order.fasta --run RUN_DIR --screening PROVIDER_RECORD.json` (PROVIDER_RECORD.json is the screening record from the synthesis provider). Order only on exit code 0 (cleared); 2 = blocked, 3 = not screened.
steps.narrative: Order codon-optimised gene for Major outer membrane protein P.IA (porA). A person does this step; the robot does not. Outsourced to vendor. A gate must hold before the next step; its full text is in the gate field of this step. Coarse duration estimate: 7-21 days (not measured).
steps.title: Order codon-optimised gene for Major outer membrane protein P.IA (porA)

steps.narrative: Clone into His-tagged expression vector. The robot can do this step. Liquid handling + temperature module. It follows s01. Reagents: expression vector, assembly mix. Controls: no-insert assembly. Coarse duration estimate: 1-3 days (not measured).
steps.title: Clone into His-tagged expression vector

steps.narrative: Transform expression host. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Temperature module; plating is manual. It follows s02. Controls: untransformed host on selection plate. Coarse duration estimate: 1-2 days (not measured).
steps.title: Transform expression host

steps.narrative: Colony PCR to confirm insert. The robot can do this step. Reaction assembly only. It follows s03. Controls: empty-vector colony; no-template. Coarse duration estimate: 0.5-1 days (not measured).
steps.title: Colony PCR to confirm insert

steps.automation_note: Inducer addition yes; shaking incubation no.
steps.narrative: Small-scale expression and induction. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Inducer addition yes; shaking incubation no. It follows s04. Controls: uninduced culture. Coarse duration estimate: 1-2 days (not measured).
steps.title: Small-scale expression and induction

steps.narrative: Lyse cells; clarify lysate. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Reagent addition yes; sonication/centrifugation no. It follows s05. Coarse duration estimate: 0.5-1 days (not measured).
steps.title: Lyse cells; clarify lysate

steps.automation_note: Magnetic-bead His-tag format yes; gravity column/FPLC no.
steps.gate: Soluble protein recovered; if not, candidate falsified at expression (see falsifier).
steps.narrative: Ni-NTA (His-tag) purification. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Magnetic-bead His-tag format yes; gravity column/FPLC no. It follows s06. Controls: empty-vector lysate mock purification. Gate before the next step: Soluble protein recovered; if not, candidate falsified at expression (see falsifier). Coarse duration estimate: 1-2 days (not measured).
steps.title: Ni-NTA (His-tag) purification

steps.narrative: Endotoxin removal. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Plate setup yes. It follows s07. Coarse duration estimate: 0.5-1 days (not measured).
steps.title: Endotoxin removal

steps.automation_note: Plate setup yes; reading needs a plate reader.
steps.gate: Residual endotoxin below the release limit (NOT YET SET - decide before running) before ANY THP-1 work.
steps.narrative: Quantify residual endotoxin (LAL). The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Plate setup yes; reading needs a plate reader. It follows s08. Controls: LAL standard curve; buffer blank. Gate before the next step: Residual endotoxin below the release limit (NOT YET SET - decide before running) before ANY THP-1 work. Coarse duration estimate: 0.5-1 days (not measured).
steps.title: Quantify residual endotoxin (LAL)

steps.narrative: THP-1 culture and PMA differentiation. A person does this step; the robot does not. CO2 incubator, sterile handling. It follows s09. Coarse duration estimate: 3-5 days (not measured).
steps.title: THP-1 culture and PMA differentiation

controls: endotoxin-matched LPS control (at the measured residual level)
steps.narrative: Stimulate differentiated THP-1 with purified antigen. The robot can do this step. Addition to seeded plate. It follows s09, s10. Controls: vehicle/buffer only; LPS positive control; endotoxin-matched LPS control (at the measured residual level); polymyxin B-treated antigen; empty-vector mock-purification eluate. Coarse duration estimate: 1-2 days (not measured).
steps.title: Stimulate differentiated THP-1 with purified antigen

steps.automation_note: Plate setup and washes yes; reading no.
steps.narrative: ELISA readout. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Plate setup and washes yes; reading no. It follows s11. Coarse duration estimate: 1-2 days (not measured).
steps.title: ELISA readout

steps.automation_note: Reaction setup yes; thermocycling and reading no.
steps.narrative: RT QPCR readout. The robot does part of this step and a person does the rest. Reaction setup yes; thermocycling and reading no. It follows s11. Coarse duration estimate: 1-2 days (not measured).
steps.title: RT QPCR readout
